notes.title: Changelog - Version 3.03.02
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the maître's dialogue from displaying correctly in certain languages during the dinner scene.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to change the time during events, causing the player to get stuck in free-roam mode.
[*] Improved the translation of  nouns between characters for greater consistency and natural flow.
[*] Added a new music app to the protagonist's phone. Some tracks from "Our Home" are original and available on Spotify. You can now listen to them during gameplay, in events, or while in free-roam mode. The music plays on a separate audio channel, independent of other in-game sounds, and can only be controlled via the protagonist's phone.

notes.title: Meet Emily: The Beating Heart of "Our Home"
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/505c23454f6448428c379a66326add8170ea4146.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Today, we want to dedicate a special space to introduce one of the most complete and [b]enchanting[/b] characters in our visual novel: [b]Emily[/b]. If you’ve already played the initial chapters, you know that [b]Emily[/b] is not just a figure in the storyline; she is a [b]vital force[/b], a [b]gentle breeze[/b] that warms the heart and lights up the darkest paths.[/p][p]Inspired by personalities that embody [b]unwavering empathy[/b], [b]emotional resilience[/b], and a [b]purity[/b] that transcends adversities, [b]Emily[/b] represents the best of what it means to be human in a world full of uncertainties. She is the kind of character who makes you pause the game just to reflect on how [b]profound and touching[/b] a connection can be. Get ready to fall in love, because [b]Emily[/b] doesn’t just win over the protagonist; she wins over all of us.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/348d9a60a1885a9ed7ea2635e1dd97ad16ada720.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Beauty of a Soul That Radiates Light
[/b][/h3][p]Imagine a young woman whose presence is like a ray of sunlight filtered through the leaves of an ancient tree: [b]gentle[/b], [b]comforting[/b], and impossibly [b]welcoming[/b]. [b]Emily[/b], at 18 years old, possesses a beauty that goes beyond the physical, though her appearance is undoubtedly [b]captivating[/b]. Her brown hair falls in [b]natural waves[/b], framing a delicate face with fair skin and a [b]smile[/b] that seems capable of melting the hardest ice. Her [b]eyes[/b], deep and expressive, carry a [b]wonder[/b], as if she sees the world not through the scars it imposes, but through the possibilities of [b]healing[/b] and [b]love[/b] it offers.[/p][p]But what makes [b]Emily[/b] truly unforgettable is not her appearance, it’s her [b]essence[/b]. She is the embodiment of [b]unwavering kindness[/b], a [b]pure soul[/b] who spreads [b]hope[/b] as if it were the most natural thing in the world.[/p][p]Inspired by iconic figures who faced profound losses and still chose the path of [b]empathy[/b], think of heroines like [b]Meiko "Menma" Honma[/b] from [i]Anohana[/i], whose [b]optimistic joy[/b] and [b]selfless concern[/b] unite friends even beyond pain, transforming grief into [b]eternal bonds[/b]; [b]Anne Shirley[/b] from [i]Anne of Green Gables[/i], with her [b]resilient imagination[/b] and [b]kindness[/b] that wins over hardened hearts, finding beauty in life’s simplicities; [b]Scout Finch[/b] from [i]To Kill a Mockingbird[/i], [b]intelligent[/b] and [b]curious[/b], who observes the world with [b]courageous empathy[/b], defending the vulnerable with an innocence that challenges injustices; [b]Amélie Poulain[/b] from [i]Amélie[/i], [b]dreamy[/b] and [b]altruistic[/b], who performs anonymous acts of kindness to brighten others’ lives, spreading magic in the everyday; [b]Sophie[/b] from [i]Howl’s Moving Castle[/i], [b]resilient[/b] and [b]optimistic[/b], who heals emotional wounds with grace, transforming curses into journeys of [b]self-discovery[/b]; [b]Leslie Knope[/b] from [i]Parks and Recreation[/i], [b]enthusiastic[/b] and [b]loyal[/b], whose tireless dedication and light humor inspire communities to unite for the [b]common good[/b]; and [b]Anne Elliot[/b] from [i]Persuasion[/i], [b]gentle[/b] and [b]romantically vulnerable[/b], who navigates rejection with [b]quiet resilience[/b], maintaining faith in love even after years of separation.

[b]Emily[/b] is [b]loyal[/b], [b]dreamy[/b], and always ready to lend a hand. Her personality is a balm for chaos: [b]spontaneous[/b], [b]warm[/b], and [b]optimistic[/b], she listens with an open heart and responds with a [b]wisdom[/b] that comes from the soul. In the game, you see her in everyday moments that reveal her [b]depth[/b], like when she offers support to the protagonist after years apart, or when she tries to unite a divided family with [b]infinite patience[/b]. [b]Emily[/b] is not perfect; she is [b]human[/b], and that’s exactly what makes her so [b]captivating[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/8b81507383383e81f353a3f5f2c30d305e3bb09b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]A Journey of Loss, Love, and Redemption
[/b][/h3][p]The story of [b]Emily[/b] is a tapestry woven with threads of [b]tragedy[/b] and [b]triumph[/b], a narrative that echoes real inspirations of [b]overcoming[/b] and [b]unconditional kindness[/b]. Orphaned as a child after the loss of her parents, [b]Emily[/b] found refuge in the orphanage run by [b]Amélia[/b], where her [b]inner light[/b] shone even on the darkest days. There, she became a source of [b]comfort[/b] for others, including the protagonist and their friend [b]Jonathan[/b], spreading [b]joy[/b] through simple gestures, like sharing stories or offering a [b]friendly shoulder[/b]. Her adoption by [b]Lana[/b] at age 7 marked the beginning of a new phase: a life of contrasts, with the [b]comfort of a home[/b] but also the challenges of a [b]complicated family[/b].

In the game, you follow [b]Emily[/b] in her transition to adulthood, navigating her [b]adoption[/b], the [b]jealousy[/b] of [b]Sabrina[/b], and the [b]emotional reunion[/b] with the [b]MC[/b] after years apart. Remember the scene where [b]Emily[/b], upon seeing the [b]MC[/b] on the street, exclaims: [b]"I thought I'd never see you again. I'm so surprised and happy to find you here"[/b]? That moment captures her essence: a blend of [b]vulnerability[/b] and [b]pure joy[/b], making the player's heart race. Or when, in the garden, she insists on helping despite her inexperience, and the protagonist says: [b]"You've always been an amazing girl, Emily"[/b], though it’s the protagonist who praises her, [b]Emily[/b] responds with [b]humility[/b] and [b]gratitude[/b], showcasing her [b]resilience[/b]. These moments aren’t random; they are inspired by themes of [b]loss[/b] and [b]reconnection[/b], where [b]Emily[/b] represents the [b]hope[/b] that [b]love[/b] can heal old wounds.

Her central motivation, to spread [b]joy[/b] and unite people with [b]love[/b], drives her to face internal conflicts, like [b]excessive self-sacrifice[/b]. In chapters like [b]"The New Begin"[/b], you see [b]Emily[/b] trying to balance her [b]kindness[/b] with the demands of real life, such as helping in the garden or dealing with [b]family tension[/b]. She dreams of overcoming [b]Sabrina’s jealousy[/b], believing that [b]"We're in this together, as a family"[/b], a line that reflects her [b]unwavering faith[/b] in the power of [b]connection[/b]. [b]Emily[/b] is not naive; she is [b]idealistic[/b], and her journey in the game explores how that [b]purity[/b] can be tested but never broken.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/e7086cbf057044badc4e95a72570fd0d32d20f1d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Dialogues and Moments That Make You Fall in Love[/b][/h3][p]What makes [b]Emily[/b] so vivid and [b]captivating[/b] are her dialogues, filled with [b]warmth[/b], [b]empathy[/b], and a touch of [b]innocence[/b] that melts any resistance. In the chapters, she shines in interactions that reveal [b]deep layers[/b]. For example, in the reunion with the [b]MC[/b] in [b]"The Reunion"[/b], she says: [b]"You... you're still as lovely as ever. I mean... I mean..."[/b], stumbling over her words but conveying a [b]raw emotion[/b] that makes the player feel the weight of the years apart. Or in [b]"The New Begin"[/b], while helping in the garden: [b]"I spent some time in the orphanage, remember. We were always cooking there."[/b], a simple line that evokes [b]shared memories[/b] and reinforces her [b]resilience[/b].[/p][p]In more intimate moments, like the phone call after the reunion: [b]"Hi, Dylan. Sorry for not staying to chat. My sister tends to be dramatic most of the time."[/b], [b]Emily[/b] shows her [b]patience[/b] and [b]light humor[/b], even while dealing with [b]family tensions[/b]. And who doesn’t fall for her declaration of [b]eternal friendship[/b]? [b]"You've always been an amazing girl, Emily. Stop it, you're making me blush."[/b] No, wait: it’s the [b]MC[/b] praising her, but [b]Emily[/b] responds with [b]genuine gratitude[/b], highlighting her [b]humility[/b]. These dialogues aren’t just lines; they are [b]windows into a soul[/b] that loves [b]unconditionally[/b], inspired by personalities who transform [b]pain into empathy[/b], like those who face losses and still choose [b]light[/b].[/p][p]Another unforgettable scene is in [b]"The Big House"[/b], where [b]Emily[/b] reflects: [b]"Maybe I'm happy to help Mirella."[/b] a glimpse of her [b]altruistic kindness[/b] that extends to everyone around her. These moments build a character who isn’t perfect, she has weaknesses like [b]naive idealism[/b] and difficulty asserting herself, but that’s precisely what makes her [b]real[/b] and [b]irresistible[/b]. You, the player, feel like you could be her friend, confide secrets, and maybe even something more.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/c913077beb124aaa1f1c134c865d1053397c2bd5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Relationships That Define Emily – And Her Role in the Game[/h3][p]At the heart of [b]"Our Home"[/b], [b]Emily[/b] is the link that binds everything together: a [b]loyal ally[/b], a [b]confidante[/b], and, potentially, a [b]deep love[/b]. Her bond with the [b]protagonist[/b] is the core of the story, a [b]childhood love[/b] rekindled, filled with [b]nostalgia[/b] and [b]promises[/b]. In scenes like the reunion, she says: [b]"I've wanted to do this for a long time"[/b], a romantic teaser that sets pulses racing. With [b]Lana[/b], [b]Emily[/b] is an [b]unwavering support[/b], helping in moments of crisis, such as in the kitchen or garden, always with lines like: [b]"We're in this together."[/b][/p][p]With [b]Sabrina[/b], the conflict is palpable, [b]Emily[/b] yearns for [b]unity[/b], saying: [b]"Please, Sabrina, it's not the time for arguments"[/b], but faces rejection, highlighting her [b]resilience[/b]. These relationships are not static; your choices shape [b]Emily[/b]’s path, whether by deepening the [b]romance[/b] with the [b]MC[/b] or helping her [b]reconcile the family[/b].[/p][p][b]Emily[/b] is inspired by figures who embody [b]empathy[/b] and [b]overcoming[/b], transforming [b]tragedies[/b] into acts of [b]kindness[/b], maintaining [b]purity[/b] amidst chaos. In the game, she represents themes of [b]unconditional love[/b] and [b]redemption[/b], guiding the player through an [b]emotional journey[/b] that goes beyond the +18 rating: it’s about [b]real connections[/b], [b]vulnerabilities[/b], and the power of an [b]open heart[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/c700bd5038224ccc3d2e7f3bc0b671b2b1c30a56.png"][/img][/p][h3]Why Emily Is Unforgettable – And Why You’ll Fall in Love[/h3][p][b]Emily[/b] is not just a character; she is the [b]pulsing heart[/b] of [b]"Our Home"[/b]. Her [b]unwavering kindness[/b], inspired by real souls who choose [b]light[/b] despite the darkness, makes her a presence that [b]transcends the game[/b]. She reminds us that, even after [b]losses[/b], [b]love[/b] can heal, and that’s what makes her so [b]captivating[/b]. Imagine a young woman who, after years apart, says to the [b]MC[/b]: [b]"I want to get to know more about you"[/b], with a [b]sincerity[/b] that melts barriers. Or who, amidst [b]family conflicts[/b], insists: [b]"It's going to be okay, you'll see."[/b][/p][p]If you haven’t played yet, dive into [b]"Our Home"[/b] and discover [b]Emily[/b] for yourself. Share in the comments: which moment with her touched you the most? We’re excited for updates that will explore her [b]journey[/b] even further, stay tuned! [b]Emily[/b] is waiting to win your heart.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting [b]"Our Home"[/b]! Let’s create memories together. 💖[/p]

notes.title: Alexandra Blanchett: The Magnetic Force Igniting Our Home
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, everyone! As the creator of [b]Our Home[/b], I’m [b]thrilled[/b] to kick off a [b]series of posts[/b] about the characters that make our novel so [i]unique[/i] (at least, in our opinion ). And who better to start this journey than [b]Alexandra Blanchett[/b], the rector of Pinepool National University? She’s been stealing the spotlight in recent updates, making her the [i]perfect starting point[/i]. She’s a [b]magnetic force[/b], blending [i]elegance[/i], [i]intelligence[/i], and a fiery passion for living every moment to the fullest. Ready to dive into her essence? In the comments, let us know: [i]What do you think of Alexandra, and which Our Home character do you want to meet next?[/i] Let’s dive in! 🌟

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/bdbf23c59413d412fafeb56021037bfc62d1c682.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]The Essence of Alexandra[/h2][p] [b]Alexandra Blanchett[/b] is [i]pure impact[/i]. At 40, with [i]impeccably styled silver hair[/i] and [i]ice-blue eyes[/i] that seem to read your soul, she commands any room with a presence that’s both [i]intimidating[/i] and [i]captivating[/i]. Her [b]haute couture outfits[/b] tailored dresses, high heels, sophisticated accessories are an extension of her personality, where “[i]every movement is calculated and deliberate[/i].” As Pinepool’s rector, she shapes minds with [b]razor-sharp intelligence[/b], but what defines her is her passion for [i]experiences that awaken the senses[/i], like when she guides the protagonist to savor a refined dish, turning a simple meal into a [b]life lesson[/b].

[/p][h2]Hedonism: The Heart of Her Philosophy[/h2][p] At the core of this pursuit lies [b]hedonism[/b] a philosophy celebrating [b]pleasure[/b] as a path to self-discovery. Inspired by figures like [i]Lord Henry Wotton[/i], who provokes with bold ideas, [i]Epicurus[/i], who finds balance in pleasure, [i]Aristippus of Cyrene[/i], who values all pleasures, and [i]Frida Kahlo[/i], with her passionate authenticity, Alexandra lives to feel and inspire feeling. At a dinner with the protagonist, she challenges: “[i]Feel the flavor, the texture. What does it awaken in you?[/i]” using a scallop carpaccio to open his mind. For her, pleasure isn’t just sensory it’s [b]intellectual[/b], [b]emotional[/b], a way to reveal who you can become.

[/p][h2]An Unmatched Mentor[/h2][p] This [b]hedonistic approach[/b] makes Alexandra an [b]unparalleled mentor[/b]. She doesn’t just teach; she [i]provokes[/i], [i]inspires[/i], and pushes you to be more. When she meets the protagonist, a young orphan without direction, she confronts him with questions like “[i]What drives you?[/i]” challenging him to find his purpose. In the library, she hands him books ranging from physics to [i]Oedipus Rewriting Destiny[/i], saying: “[i]You need to decide which door to walk through[/i].” Alexandra transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary, guiding the protagonist with a balance of [b]rigor[/b] and [b]inspiration[/b] that sparks growth without him even noticing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/a1a153c4b647c4093985d3ec6b608e320fedf47f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]The Rector Who Shapes Legacies[/h2][p] As rector, Alexandra uses her position to craft [b]legacies[/b]. Her [b]strategic intelligence[/b] places her at the helm of Pinepool National University, where she doesn’t just manage she creates opportunities for unlikely talents. “[i]I don’t invest in empty promises[/i],” she warns the protagonist, offering him a special scholarship without an entrance exam. This choice reflects her vision of shaping minds, turning raw potential into something [b]brilliant[/b], like a sculptor seeing a masterpiece hidden in stone.

[/p][h2]The Diamond in the Rough[/h2][p] Why the protagonist? Because Alexandra sees him as a [b]diamond in the rough[/b], an 18-year-old with no roots but a spark she wants to polish. Her bet is a risk justifying the scholarship demands he prove his worth but also proof of her skill as a mentor. At a dinner, she speaks of desire: “[i]Chocolate, like desire, demands that you surrender[/i],” guiding him to feel and think beyond the obvious. Alexandra doesn’t control; she [b]illuminates[/b], challenging him to forge his own path.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/ae9d54e8372a969360b7a67f276c41159ee4f04b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Alexandra in Action[/h2][p] In the game, Alexandra shines in moments that blend [b]sophistication[/b] and [b]depth[/b]. In the library, she hands the protagonist a book about rewriting fate, prompting him to question his own story. At a dinner outside the city, she transforms a chocolate cardamom dish into a life lesson, saying: “[i]It’s desire that makes you alive[/i].” Each scene is a dance of mentorship, where Alexandra captivates and challenges, making the protagonist rethink what it means to live fully.

[/p][h2]Why Alexandra Will Captivate You[/h2][p] Alexandra is more than a rector she’s a [b]force of nature[/b]. Her [b]charisma[/b], [b]mystery[/b], and ability to turn every moment into a lesson will make you fall in love. She pushes the protagonist out of his shell, but also challenges [i]you[/i] to ask: [i]What would you do with a mentor like her?[/i] Whether in the library or at a sensory dinner, Alexandra invites you to feel more, think more, be more.

[/p][h2]Join the Journey![/h2][p] Want to unravel Alexandra’s layers and live her journey with the protagonist? Dive into Our Home and discover her! This is just the start of our series on the characters and their inspirations. [i]What did you think of Alexandra?[/i] Who do you want to meet next? The enigmatic [b]Norah[/b] with her secrets? The provocative [b]Matilda[/b] full of attitude? Or the stylish [b]Lorena[/b] stealing the show? Drop your thoughts in the comments and support the project on! Let’s build this world together! 🌟[/p]

notes.title: Changelog - Version 3.03.01

[/list]

notes.title: Our Home Update – New Features, Improvements, and Pioneers Vault DLC
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, community! 

First and foremost, we want to clarify that this is not the planned update for June but rather an interim version with fixes, improvements, and new content. While this update brings playable additions, they do not advance the main storyline, focusing instead on extra content to enrich your experience. [/p][p][/p][h2]Why this update?[/h2][p]Originally, we planned to release the next major update on 06/27. However, due to the need for additional adjustments, that version is not yet ready. To ensure compatibility with our upcoming release, the DLC [i]Pioneers Vault[/i], we are providing this interim update. We apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding.

[/p][h2]Introducing the Pioneers Vault DLC[/h2][p]Now available to add to your Steam wishlist, the [b]Pioneers Vault[/b] DLC offers exclusive content for fans of [i]Our Home[/i]. This DLC includes:
[/p][list][*][p][b]Secret photo gallery[/b] fully unlocked.
    [/p][/*][*][p][b]Replay gallery[/b] unlocked to revisit memorable moments.
    [/p][/*][*][p][b]Step-by-step guide[/b] with tips for making the best decisions in the game.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
The [i]Pioneers Vault[/i] will be regularly updated with new extra content to enhance gameplay. All features are optional and can be activated individually through a dedicated menu.

[b]Note:[/b] This DLC will be available for purchase [i]only during early access[/i]. After the official release of [i]Our Home[/i], it will no longer be available, at least not with all the planned content.

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3791020/Our_Home__Pioneers_Vault_DLC/" style="button"]Add Pioneers Vault to your wishlist[/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/a866d28f5acab91cf67b22b75f80ca1db65d4890.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's New in This Update[/h2][p]This version introduces new and experimental content we’re testing to improve [i]Our Home[/i]:
[/p][list][*][p][b]New Lorena character quiz[/b]: Test your knowledge about the character!
    [/p][/*][*][p][b]6 new secret images[/b]: Discover them by exploring the game.
    [/p][/*][*][p][b]Free-roam event with Lorena[/b]: A new casual content to interact with the character.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
The free-roam event can be accessed by disabling Visual Novel (VN) mode and checking Lorena’s personal calendar.

[/p][h2]Sprite Experiments: Speeding Up Development[/h2][p]We’re testing a new sprite technique to streamline the creation of casual content, such as conversations that enrich the storyline. In this update, we applied this approach to Lorena’s free-roam event, following a successful test with the character Hicco.

This technique will not replace the complex scenes in [i]Our Home[/i], which will maintain their high level of detail. However, sprites allow us to add lighter interactions more quickly, keeping the game dynamic, and will only be used for casual free-roam scenes. When a free-roam scene requires more complex interactions, such as a sex scene or something more intimate, the standard storytelling format will be used. [/p][p][/p][p]We’d love your feedback on this new feature! If it’s well-received, we’ll continue implementing it in future updates.  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/94e7b2a1412bdec1b4288e7a51c95c587c219e5a.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Improvements in Free-Roam and VN Mode Integration[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve worked to make the Visual Novel (VN) and free-roam modes more seamless. Now, after completing the main storyline content, you can explore the map and find secret images without switching modes. This change makes transitions between modes smoother and ensures you have playable content even after finishing the story, keeping the fun going until the next update. When the new version is released, your progress will automatically load, and you’ll continue the story from where you left off, just like in any other game. While this integration may feel a bit challenging at first, our goal is to make it increasingly intuitive over time.  [/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next?[/h2][p]The next update is in development and will be released as soon as it’s ready, which should take about 10 days. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience and continued support. [i]Our Home[/i] is a work in progress, and your feedback is essential in shaping the game’s future.

[/p][hr][p]

Thank you for being part of the [i]Our Home[/i] journey!

[/p][/hr]

notes.title: New Update Now Available: More Content and Improvements in the Game!
notes.notes:
Hello, [b]Our Home[/b] community!

We have great news: we've decided to [b]release the new update ahead of schedule[/b]! This doesn't replace the update planned for next month, which remains confirmed. This means more content for you in less time! Here are the highlights of this version:

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]~840 renders, ~20,000 words[/b] (about 1h10 of reading), 3 animations, 9 secret renders, and 1 new achievement.

[*][b]Revamped Environments[/b]: Norah’s house, the rental room, and Aquila now feature higher-quality renders, 
enhanced realism, and expanded scenes, setting the stage for free-roam mode.

[*][b]New Navigation Model[/b]: An experimental integration between Visual Novel (VN) and free-roam modes. After completing the story in VN mode, explore new areas and find extra content without switching modes. In the future, we aim to fully integrate VN and free-roam modes, eliminating the need to switch at the end of the game's story.

[*][b]Meet Hicco, the Curious Parrot![/b]: An experimental feature for free-roam mode. Interact with Hicco, a talkative parrot flying around PinePool, offering challenges with riddles based on town conversations. Solve them to unlock items! This mechanic uses simpler animations for casual interactions, allowing more free-roam content without compromising the quality of unique story interactions. This approach aims to speed up the development of free-roam events, our next focus after releasing the prologue rework, which you've already enjoyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/1bd20e229bbbc4bc97fdc15468f5279df2565afa.gif[/img]

[*] We've fixed several minor bugs found during development.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
Version 3.03, already in production, will be larger, focusing on the protagonist and more elaborate scenes (including some [i]spicier[/i] ones!).

[h2]We Hope You Enjoy It![/h2]
What do you think of Hicco and the new navigation model? Leave your comments, suggestions, or criticism here or on our contact channels. See you soon!

notes.title: Our Home Update: Progress and Plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, welcome to the Our Home update status!

In this post, we want to share what you can expect from the next Steam update and give you a glimpse into our process. As outlined in the Early Access details, our updates roll out quarterly. This approach lets us plan the scope of each release and the playtime you’ll enjoy.

Based on our development capacity, we produce around 400 renders per month, translating to about 30 minutes of gameplay or reading. Over a quarter, that’s roughly 1200 renders and 1h30 of new content. Our Home has a special trait: we believe every character’s expression and line matters for deeper immersion. That’s why we craft about 1 renders per dialogue. Not everyone might notice this while playing, but it’s something we take pride in delivering for you.


[h3]What’s Ready So Far[/h3]

As of now, here’s what we’ve accomplished: since February 26, we’ve created around 490 renders, 3 animations, and about 35 minutes of gameplay. This version spans two distinct moments: the start of a temp job at Aquila with Norah’s schedule, featuring some intense scenes, and a college interview with Alexandra, plus a short segment of Samantha’s investigation. These are the highlights of this update, and below, you’ll find preview images of what’s coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/6b579a82430584ae6d29c9230d72feca6c311941.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/70b10d44ce073ebedeb67b1af66ccc5609386ba7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/21c2230e06973885324626d6b068fd5420b8af8e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/87c2dbee9e5617b7c0aa71a2954381ff3116a6bc.jpg[/img]


We know many of you are eager for the next update and might wonder, “Why not release it already?” We get that excitement! Our focus is on keeping Our Home sustainable long-term, delivering meaningful, polished content each quarter. This strategy ensures more playtime and a richer experience with every release something we think you’ll love.

We’re thrilled about what’s ahead and keeping a close eye on everything you share with us. The next status report will bring even more news, and we’re counting on you to join us on this ride!

notes.title: New Update: Tweaks and Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We’re here with a new update bringing improvements. This isn’t an update with new content, but rather tweaks and fixes to make your experience even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into the details:

[b]New Features and Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Virtual Keyboard for Controllers[/b]
Now, players using controllers have a virtual keyboard to make things easier. Whether on PC or Steam Deck, interacting is simpler without switching devices.

[*][b]Interface Font Adjustments[/b]
We’ve increased font sizes across the interface for comfortable reading, especially on Steam Deck, but also on other platforms. Everything’s more legible and prettier!

[*][b]Landscape Photos on Mobile[/b]
Added support for landscape photos on mobile, with automatic -90º rotation after capture. Your images now stay at the right angle effortlessly.

[*][b]Game Image Overhaul[/b]
We’ve adjusted 100% of the images to reduce texture sharpness, better aligning them with the characters’ ages. We found a post-processing issue that made skins sharper than intended;
[list]
[*][i]What does this mean?[/i] Almost the entire game will need to be re-downloaded due to this massive fix. We apologize for the inconvenience, but the result is worth it: textures now match the vision we planned.
[*][i]Going forward?[/i] We’ve tweaked post-processing to prevent this from happening again.
[/list]
[/list]

Below is an example of this correction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/5ef20ee0f2b288e872bdbb1d01a391a5497e2bc6.jpg[/img]


[b]Bug Fixes and Tweaks[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed minor UI bugs to polish everything up.
[*]Adjusted message sorting! Contacts with the latest messages now appear first in most cases, keeping the timeline clear and improving the experience when a message arrives mid-event.
[/list]

[b]Narrative Consistency and the Prologue[/b]

After reworking the prologue, we knew we’d need to tweak the narrative between the first psychologist visit and Samantha’s initial investigation mission. Our original plan was to do this gradually, focusing on new content and render quality for that section.

[list]
[*][i]Why now?[/i] With the image fixes due to unwanted sharpness, we decided to tackle this narrative revision early. It delayed the update a bit, but it felt like the right time.
[*][i]What changed?[/i] Nothing in the story itself – we just refined the text to better reflect character personalities and align with the new prologue.
[*][i]What’s next?[/i] Moving forward, we’ll only enhance images in this section, leaving the text as is. We believe the adjustments meet our goals.
[*][i]Do I need to replay?[/i] Not required, but if you’d like to revisit the dialogues and share feedback, we’re always open to hearing from you!
[/list]

This update reflects our commitment to improving the game and listening to the community. Thank you for sticking with us on this journey – your comments and support make all the difference. See you in-game!

notes.title: Understanding Features and Settings in Our Home
notes.notes:
[h1=top]Hello, [i]Our Home[/i] players! 🏡[/h1]

We understand that some settings or features might not be immediately clear, so we’ve put together this official to help you navigate the core aspects of the game. While most of these details are already available in-game as tooltips when you hover over each function, this guide consolidates everything into one handy reference. Below, you’ll find detailed explanations of each feature, where to find them, and how they work. Our goal is to ensure your experience is as smooth as possible, whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned player. Let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr]

[h2=main-menu]1. Main Menu[/h2]

The Main Menu is the first screen you see when you launch the game. It contains the core options to start or customize your experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/13e29631a064e373575fa45fdff32613c79573d2.png[/img]

[i]The Main Menu screen of Our Home[/i]

[list]
    [*][b]Start:[/b] Opens a submenu with two initial options:
    [list]
        [*][b]Start from Scratch:[/b] Begins a new adventure. You can choose between two gameplay modes:
        [list]
            [*][u]Free-Roam:[/u] A fully open Free-Roam mode where you can explore events, actions, and secrets—including exclusive easter eggs—without any grinding. You have the freedom to navigate and engage with the world at your own pace. While the mode is fully functional and provides a solid experience, we’re still working on enhancements, such as adding new events to make it even more engaging. You can switch to VN Mode at any time without losing progress (see details in the “Game” section).
            [*][u]VN Mode:[/u] A narrative-focused mode ideal for players who prefer a more streamlined reading experience while still retaining free-roam navigation within events. You can enable or disable this mode at any time, giving you full flexibility.
        [/list]
        [*][b]Load from Cloud:[/b] Retrieves your progress saved in the cloud, including nearly all game data: progress, relationships, unlocked locations, replays, secret images, phone contacts, character info, settings, and more. Please note that this is not an official Steam feature but a completely optional function we’ve implemented. Use it carefully to avoid any risk of disrupting your local save files.
    [/list]

    [*][b]Load:[/b] Allows you to load a locally saved game to continue where you left off.
    [*][b]Preferences:[/b] Opens the settings menu (detailed below).
    [*][b]Gallery:[/b] Displays the secret images you’ve unlocked throughout the game.
    [*][b]Replay:[/b] Lists available replays, letting you relive notable scenes.
    [*][b]Help:[/b] Provides a submenu with explanations of controls and basic Ren’Py functions.
    [*][b]Quit:[/b] Closes the game.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2=prefs-menu]2. Preferences Menu (Settings)[/h2]

[b]Where to Find:[/b] Accessible from the Main Menu or by pausing the game (usually with the ESC key or a designated button). This menu lets you customize various aspects of the game to suit your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/4e777ef8d04c0f4f0befbe48e720e9de44bbb837.png[/img]

[i]The Preferences Menu lets you fine-tune your experience[/i]

[h3]Game[/h3]
General settings that affect gameplay and visual experience:

[list]
    [*][b]VN Mode:[/b] Enables/disables Visual Novel Mode, focusing on main events for a more linear narrative. Even in this mode, free-roam navigation within events is preserved. You can toggle between VN Mode and Free-Roam at any time without losing progress.
    [*][b]Legacy Skip Time:[/b] Activates the older time-skipping system, allowing you to skip forward by 1, 2, or 3 hours instead of jumping directly to a specific time on the calendar. (Free-roam mode)
    [*][b]Mini-games:[/b] When enabled, automatically skips all mini-games and marks them as completed.  (Free-roam mode)
    [*][b]Save Name:[/b] Allows you to manually name your save files.
    [*][b]Transitions:[/b] Toggles visual transitions (images and videos) that indicate changes in time or location.
    [*][b]Hover Navigation:[/b] Lets you move between environments in Free-Roam Mode by simply hovering your mouse over location-change buttons—no clicking needed. This speeds up exploration, but clicking still works if you prefer.
    [*][b]Side Image:[/b] Shows a character’s image next to the dialogue box when enabled.
    [*][b]Particles:[/b] Toggles the particle system (e.g. floating dust) for added immersion. Disable for a cleaner screen or better performance on lower-end devices.
    [*][b]Mouse Point:[/b] Sets the mouse cursor to your operating system’s default style. Requires a game restart to apply changes.
    [*][b]Hide Windows:[/b] Adds a button to hide all windows in the dialogue box.
    [*][b]Proofreader:[/b] When enabled (requires internet), adds a button in dialogues and choices to report text or translation errors directly to the development team.
    [*][b]Proofreader Interface:[/b] Similar to Proofreader but adds the reporting button to interface elements (e.g. Main Menu labels).
[/list]

[h3]Dialogue[/h3]
Options to customize how dialogue is displayed:

[list]
    [*][b]Change Color of Dialogue and Choices:[/b] Adjusts the text color of dialogues and choices.
    [*][b]Change Color of Thoughts:[/b] Adjusts the text color of character thoughts.
    [*][b]Text Speed:[/b] Controls how quickly text appears.
    [*][b]Dialogue Box Transparency:[/b] Sets the level of transparency for the dialogue box.
    [*][b]Dialogue Text Size:[/b] Adjusts the font size of dialogue text.
    [*][b]Character Name Size:[/b] Adjusts the font size of character names.
    [*][b]Choice Text Size:[/b] Adjusts the font size of choice options.
[/list]

[h3]Skip[/h3]
Settings for skipping game content:

[list]
    [*][b]Skip Unseen:[/b] Allows skipping of unseen dialogue or scenes (use carefully to avoid missing key content).
    [*][b]Skip After Choice:[/b] Continues skipping automatically after you make a choice.
[/list]

[h3]Rollback[/h3]
Controls the rollback feature to revisit past content:

[list]
    [*][b]Disabled:[/b] Disables rollback for a strictly linear experience.
    [*][b]Left:[/b] Allows rewinding the game (scroll wheel or specific inputs) to review past dialogue.
    [*][b]Forward:[/b] After rolling back, lets you move forward again to return to your previous point.
[/list]

[h3]Sound[/h3]
Audio adjustments for your experience:

[list]
    [*][b]Music:[/b] Controls the background music volume.
    [*][b]Sound Effects:[/b] Adjusts the volume of SFX, including one-time sounds, moans, and loops.
    [*][b]Mute Control:[/b] Adds quick mute/unmute buttons for audio channels in the dialogue box.
[/list]

[h3]Video[/h3]
Video settings (available only on PC):

[list]
    [*][b]Display Window:[/b] Runs the game in windowed mode (useful for multitasking).
    [*][b]Display Full Screen:[/b] Runs the game in full-screen mode for greater immersion.
[/list]

[h3]Language[/h3]
Choose the game’s language from the available options.

[h3]Relations[/h3]
Lets you adjust how characters refer to each other (in third-person or groups), customizing dialogues and interactions.

[hr][/hr]

[h2=other-key-features]3. Other Key Features[/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Gallery:[/b] Displays unlocked secret images (accessible from the Main Menu).
    [*][b]Replay:[/b] Lets you revisit specific scenes (accessible from the Main Menu).
    [*][b]Help:[/b] Provides explanations of controls and basic functions (accessible from the Main Menu).
    [*][b]Load:[/b] Loads locally saved games (available in the Main Menu or by pausing the game).
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2=questions-issues]Questions or Issues?[/h2]

If you still have questions or need assistance with any feature, feel free to leave a comment or reach out through our official channels (such as our Discord). We’re here to ensure your experience with [i]Our Home[/i] is the best it can be!

notes.title: Our Home – Launching Today on Steam in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[quote]Welcome, everyone!

We're just hours away from launching Our Home on Steam in Early Access, and we can’t wait to share this journey with you! First and foremost, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way—your energy has brought us to this moment.

Now, let’s get to the good part: what you can expect from this release![/quote]

[hr][/hr]


[h1]A Growing Experience: From Wishlist to Early Access[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/b078cd3afa4f49df832c46858cfafc01c2ee0bbd.png[/img]

Since we announced our Wishlist, we have been working hard to expand and refine the experience, adding more depth to the story, visuals, and gameplay.

[b]Where We Started[/b]

At the time of the Wishlist announcement, Our Home already had:
🖼️ 5,700 high-quality images
🎬 52 animations, enriching the visual experience
💬 5,403 dialogue blocks, forming a deep narrative with 61,931 words
📖 An estimated 5-hour read time, offering a significant immersion in the initial story

But we didn’t stop there!

[b]What We Added[/b]

With continuous development, we expanded the game time by more than 90 minutes, introducing new content focused on the main story. These improvements dive deeper into the mysteries of Norah’s past and present, while Samantha’s investigations uncover hidden connections—with our hero at the center of it all.

🔥 1,700+ brand-new renders, crafted to bring emotional and detailed scenes to life
🔍 Secret renders for those who love to explore every hidden detail

This massive expansion set the stage for our biggest update yet—the complete rework of the prologue!


[hr][/hr]

[h1]A Prologue Designed for Immersion[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/4a5258a30fab8a4b6e353d79975bdc77a4e292e9.png[/img]


This launch includes a special prologue rework, built from the ground up over the past 12 months. We've rewritten scenes, refined the narrative, and enhanced the visuals to create a rich and engaging experience right from the start.

Here’s what we’ve achieved:
✅ Renders: Increased from ~600 to over 1,400
✅ Dialogues: Expanded from ~100 to over 1,300
✅ Word Count: From ~1,000 to over 24,000
✅ Average Playtime: From 20 minutes to over 1.5 hours

Our goal is simple: to deliver a compelling story with characters you'll want to connect with. The prologue rework introduces the MC and their world—from their bonds with Amelia and Jonathan to MC ’s deep love for Emily—all with more detail and emotion.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Behind the Creation[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/f665ff521c5cac89555ccaa2287490b0a5d2e47e.png[/img]

When I first envisioned Our Home, I wanted a strong narrative, with a clear path and a memorable ending. Become a writer and choosing 3D and storytelling was a massive challenge—I lacked both the resources and experience at the beginning.

But over time, with incredible support from my wife, we turned this vision into reality. This prologue rework is the result of months of learning and dedication, and we’re proud to present it as the starting point of our journey on Steam.


[hr][/hr]
[h1]What to Expect in the Prologue?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/067a770e6b21f8ecd6b14349a2b87ce2073b61d4.png[/img]

👤 Amelia – Deeper connections with the other characters and the impact of the MC’s departure from the orphanage.
🤝 Jonathan & MC – A friendship brought to life, setting the stage for what's to come.
❤️ MC & Emily – A love explored through special scenes, showing why she means so much.
🌎 Others – Samantha, Hank, Juliana, Matilda, and more—all introduced naturally, with distinct personalities.

As soon as you start Our Home, you’ll dive straight into the prologue—the perfect introduction for new players like you.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Looking Ahead to 2025[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/dc0b498ed6d6cb81143d8d6521f444dfe4c64eb5.png[/img]

As an Early Access title, this is just the beginning. Our plan for 2025 is to:
🔹 Expand the free exploration content
🔹 Progress the main story
🔹 Complete Chapter 1 within 18 months
🔹 Deliver regular updates, side stories, and much more

We’re excited to build this world together with you!

[hr][/hr]

[h1]A Modern, Intuitive UI[/h1]

Over the past few months, we’ve redesigned the entire interface to make it smoother and more immersive:
🔹 Interactive menus
🔹 A gallery for scenes and hidden images
🤝 "Higram"—our in-game Instagram, featuring a personal profile and community reactions

Everything has been designed to enhance your experience!

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Launching Today[/h1]

The past months have been intense, but every effort has been worth it to bring this experience to you.
Our Home is about building something special, and as Early Access players, you are a key part of that.
🚀 See you in the game—get ready for what’s coming next!

[h2]Ready for Early Access?[/h2]
If you haven’t added [i]Our Home[/i] to your Wishlist yet, [b]do it now[/b] to receive notifications about the release and never miss an update. With over 90 minutes of additional story and [b]1,700+ new renders[/b], we’re sure you’ll dive headfirst into the world of [i]Our Home[/i]!

[b]Thank you for being with us, and see you in the next update![/b]

[i](Share your impressions in the comments — we love hearing what you think!)[/i]

notes.title: Next steps Q3/2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090469/f2865026efe83157c3b8e1516a10459ba415b7ce.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone.

This is our first post here, so I want to start by explaining to those who are not yet familiar with how our updates work.

We divide our work development into [b]quarters[/b], and each quarter we release content for a character.
Our average number of [b]renderings per quarter is 1,050[/b], and we usually create one render per dialogue, because we believe that each expression in a visual novel is important.
[b]The average reading time per quarter is 1h20m.[/b]

Our initial plan is that each character, except for the key characters in the story, will have at least 2 versions, meaning they will be in focus for 2 quarters, but not necessarily consecutive quarters, by the end of the first chapter of "Our Home." At this moment, we have the following status.

[list]
[*] Juliana: 1 Versions.
[*] Emily: 2 Versions (Key character, which means she will have more versions than the other characters.)
